summary: Master InsurTech claims automation and fraud detection through workflows, KPI dashboards, and practical controls. Book this 5-day course today.
lede: Claims automation and fraud detection training helps insurance professionals map claims workflows, identify bottlenecks, and design controlled triage and fraud checks. You’ll practice measuring cycle time, using decision tables and document extraction for first notice of loss (FNOL) triage, building fraud-scoring rules and case logs, and creating controls, dashboards, and an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is built for insurance professionals who need to improve claims handling, automation design, and fraud detection using practical tools and controlled workflows.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work with claims workflow examples, case notes, and simple dashboard views. Familiarity with Excel or a spreadsheet-based KPI report is helpful for exercises, but no programming background is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
